text: Implementing a typed Udell-style GLRM semantic layer: feature domains and embeddings, exhaustive observed/missing/inapplicable/censored states, convex entry-loss families with checked natural-parameter domains, separate factor penalties, and a mask-exact objective with explicit missingness/prediction intent. Verification will include analytic entry-loss oracles, domain failures, and the complete quadratic low-rank reduction on JVM and JS.
